speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't provided the patient's response yet. Could you please tell me your specific symptoms, how long you've had them, and if you have any medical history? Also, please note I have not requested any tests or images so far.

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning. Do you also notice yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes, and have you experienced any itching or dark urine? REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (LFTs), Bilirubin, Alkaline Phosphatase, AST, ALT, Albumin, INR.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver Function Tests: AST (Elevated), ALT (Elevated), ALP (Significantly elevated), Bilirubin (Elevated); Albumin and INR: Not included in provided data.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Poor sleep quality, Unintentional weight loss, Jaundice.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and consumes 5 alcoholic beverages per day.

speaker: Patient
text: The patient does not report any fever, abdominal pain, or changes in bowel habits. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is highly unlikely; cellulitis does not cause significant weight loss or jaundice. To clarify your current status, can you confirm if you have been diagnosed with Cellulitis by a medical professional, or is this a misunderstanding? REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CBC with differential: WBC (Normal), Hemoglobin (Normal), Platelets (Normal).

speaker: Doctor
text: That is interesting; the normal CBC rules out a severe bacterial infection like the cellulitis previously suspected. Given your age, unintentional weight loss, and the physical findings of jaundice, we must investigate the liver and biliary system more urgently. Can you tell me if you have a history of alcohol use, and have you noticed any swelling in your legs or abdominal bloating? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal Ultrasound; REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound_results.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Abdominal Ultrasound Findings: Enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder. No evident stones.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Cholecystitis without cholelithiasis (likely acalculous cholecystitis).
